item.title: How to create a multi-language Angular app
item.description: Building applications that support multiple languages is essential for reaching global audiences and providing localized user experiences. As the creator of CoreUI, a widely used open-source UI library with comprehensive Angular support, I’ve implemented internationalization in enterprise applications. The most robust approach is using Angular’s built-in @angular/localize package with the i18n attribute for template translations. This method provides compile-time safety and efficient runtime translation switching.

item.title: How to translate text with Angular i18n
item.description: Implementing internationalization is crucial for Angular applications that serve users in multiple languages and regions. As the creator of CoreUI, I’ve built multilingual interfaces for global enterprise applications. The most effective solution is to use Angular’s built-in i18n system with the i18n attribute to mark translatable text. This approach integrates seamlessly with Angular’s build process and provides compile-time translation for optimal performance.
